name: LPSG download archive v2 — overlay 4 of 6
description: Adds mobile-aware configurable ZIP splitting, preflight size estimates, page-grouped archives, per-archive manifest.json metadata, and stronger cancellation/failure preservation while retaining existing direct and URL download workflows.
notes: Roadmap overlay 4 of 6. Requires overlay 3 v1 as its exact source state.
Auto ZIP part size is mobile-aware (64 MiB mobile, 512 MiB desktop) and can be overridden with 32/64/96/256/512 MiB presets.
ZIP start status reports selected count and known estimated bytes, explicitly identifying unknown-size items.
ZIP grouping can archive the full selection or create page-scoped archives; page mode sorts selected media deterministically by page/order.
Every emitted ZIP contains manifest.json with archive/job metadata, file names, type, page/post attribution, source/original URL, size, and relevant failed entries.
Existing pause/cancel/retry-failed behavior is retained; cancellation/crash now preserves failures already observed for retry/export.
Existing URL export and direct-download behavior is untouched.
Audit pass 1 fixed page-part naming and made failed manifest entries page-relevant without duplication.
Audit pass 2 fixed deterministic page grouping so arbitrary selection order cannot create duplicate page archive runs.
Audit pass 3 found no remaining promised-scope gaps; node --check and archive contract assertions passed.
